name: timerCancel
description: Triggered when a timer is cancelled by hand

name: timerDrop
description: Triggered when a stored timer is thrown away without running, with the reason in $env[reason]

name: timerFire
description: Triggered when a timer's code runs: a timeout going off, or an interval ticking

name: timerRestore
description: Triggered when a stored timer is picked back up after a restart

name: timerStart
description: Triggered when a timer is scheduled
